requirements_to_testpoints.requirement_text: 使用 D3 引脚的按钮控制 D10 LED 开关，按一次切换一次状态。
requirements_to_testpoints.stimulus: Press io_0 from false to true (one rising edge), then hold io_0 true for at least one control step, then release io_0 back to false, repeat for a second rising edge.
requirements_to_testpoints.oracle: io_1 toggles once on each io_0 rising edge (first press makes io_1 true, next press makes io_1 false), with no change while io_0 remains held and no change on release.
